C1828.title: David et al.: Formal Classification of Crawler Traps and a General Detection and Evasion Method
C1828.summary: Research by David, Delong, and Filiol on crawler trap detection was published in the Journal of Computer Virology and Hacking Techniques. The paper addresses websites that use dynamically generated similar pages, random content, infinite-depth or looping structures to consume crawler resources, and proposes detection ideas based on machine learning and page information distance. Claims about ICISSP 2020, February 2020, or first formal classification should be supported by conference proceedings or paper text.
